messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Vector Network Analyzer in Wireless Communication, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### Recommended focus areas
| Opportunity area | What current evidence supports | Supporting Raw evidence | Evidence strength |
|---|---|---|---|
| Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G in mobile network infrastructure | The vault maps “Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G” to R&S ZNA, R&S ZNA67EXT, mmWave front ends, and frequency converters.[45] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer.[66] | Direct solution mapping exists, but the source is a company-restricted solution slide.[46] |
| Digital design & power for network infrastructure | The vault maps “Digital design & power” to VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source.[45] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA and R&S ZNL as Vector Network Analyzers.[66][67] | Direct VNA need is stated, but no customer, volume, or procurement evidence is provided.[50] |
| LEO satellite user terminals, phased-array antennas, and RF front-end validation | The LEO supply-chain page defines ground equipment and user terminals as a segment centered on User Terminal, phased-array antenna, and RF front-end.[37] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer.[66] | The VNA link is weaker because the Kuiper UT page says VNA equipment and calibration methods still need to be supplemented.[30] |
| Ku / Ka-band active phased-array antenna and terminal integration ecosystem | The vault lists Ku / Ka-band active phased-array antenna, RF front-end integration, and ground terminal system integration among Taiwan LEO ground-equipment capabilities.[39] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer.[66] | The market area is supported, but the passages do not verify a specific R&S VNA sale or customer fit. |
| Wireless certification and mmWave test-house expansion | The vault says wireless certification labs cover RF, EMC, safety, conformance, spectrum, output power, DFS, SAR, protocol compatibility, interoperability, PTCRB, and GCF testing.[29] | Raw evidence lists wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, and signal & spectrum analyzer as wireless test instruments, but it does not list VNA.[65] | This is an adjacent opportunity, not a verified VNA opportunity. |

| Product line | Connectable need | Confirmed option / specification | Why it matters | Evidence | Gap / quote risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S ZNA | Higher-frequency and mmWave infrastructure testing | R&S ZNA covers 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, and 67 GHz models.[8] | The infrastructure solution map explicitly includes R&S ZNA under higher frequencies, mmWave, and early 6G.[45] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer.[66] | No passage gives a customer case or revenue opportunity. |
| R&S ZNA | RF front-end and converter-oriented work | ZNA software options include scalar mixer measurements, vector mixer measurements, mmWave converter support, group delay, pulsed-signal measurements, and noise figure measurement.[17] | These options align with RF and frequency-converting measurement needs stated in the product evidence.[17] | Raw evidence identifies R&S ZNA as a Vector Network Analyzer.[66] | The passages do not state that these options are required by any wireless customer. |
| R&S ZNA67EXT | 110 GHz mmWave extension | ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz.[22] | The infrastructure solution map includes R&S ZNA67EXT under higher frequencies, mmWave, and early 6G.[45] | Raw evidence supports the base R&S ZNA VNA identity, but not the ZNA67EXT system specifically.[66] | No Raw passage names ZNA67EXT. |
### Scenario entry points
| Scenario | Recommended combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile infrastructure higher-frequency / mmWave / early 6G | R&S ZNA or R&S ZNA67EXT with mmWave-related accessories where applicable.[45] | Lead with the solution-map evidence that names R&S ZNA and R&S ZNA67EXT for higher frequencies, mmWave, and early 6G.[45] | No passage provides standard version, configuration, price, or customer deployment.[50] |
| Network digital design & power | VNA plus probes and adjacent instruments.[45] | Lead with the solution-map evidence that explicitly lists VNA under digital design and power.[45] | No passage specifies which VNA model or option is required.[50] |
| LEO user terminal and phased-array ecosystem | Treat VNA as a test-plan gap to validate, not as a confirmed deployed solution.[30] | Lead with the evidence that UT testing still needs VNA, signal analyzer, network emulator, satellite channel emulator, equipment details, and calibration methods.[30] | Formal test plan, VNA model, calibration method, and customer case are not confirmed.[30] |
| Wireless certification labs | Do not position VNA as confirmed demand from the provided Raw evidence.[65] | Raw evidence only lists wireless communication tester, EMI test receiver, and signal & spectrum analyzer.[65] | VNA demand in certification labs is not supported by the Raw passages. |
### Limits
The network-infrastructure source is a company-restricted MWC2025 solution framework without formal document version, author, document number, or publication date [46].
The infrastructure mapping page warns that it is not a formal product roadmap, datasheet, quote configuration, or standards compliance statement [50].
The wireless certification lab source has unresolved issues around formal date, accreditation scope, equipment configuration, and Starlink / Kuiper RF validation evidence [28].

電信技術中心 › 來源中的機構描述
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）在「電信技術中心之發展簡介與願景」中說：

- 財團法人電信技術中心之設立，緣於前電信監理機關（交通部電信總局）為因應數位科技匯流，掌握資訊、通訊與產業發展動向，確保我國資通訊監理政策及法令符合國際發展趨勢，於 93年2月成立本中心。
- 設立宗旨為配合電信政策，支援電信監理、相關電信技術與產業研究，提供電信設備審驗認證服務，協助研擬電信技術標準規範，以提升電信技術。
- 來源亦稱其協助促進國際電信組織間交流與合作、保護消費者權益，以健全電信事業發展及市場交易安全。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。

- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

低軌衛星零組件與地面終端供應鏈 › 產業鏈結構
[[2026台灣無線通訊代工製造產業_技術規格與市場分析報告]]（2026-09-15）將低軌衛星產業鏈分為四大環節：

2. 地面設備與用戶終端：[[User Terminal]] / UT，核心為[[相控陣列天線]]與 [[RF front-end]]。
3. 系統整合與測試驗證。
4. 衛星營運商服務。
